cause: The metadata cwd contains NUL. Non-strict path resolution need not raise for malformed strings, so containment alone can admit the malformed descendant. The helper relied on Path.resolve raising. Both runtime readers use inside().
fix: Reject non-string or NUL-containing session cwd before filesystem path resolution. Keep existing absolute-path, canonical-resolution and containment checks.
regression: Existing test and expected output unchanged; no tests or thresholds weakened.

controlled_replay.condition: For NUL-containing paths only, substitute a permissive Path.resolve returning the same Path; all other paths use original resolve. Run the existing test through the real helper CLI on runtime-shaped JSONL files.
controlled_replay.before: The same two runtime subcases fail with the same unexpected coco-ship result.
controlled_replay.after: One test, both runtime subcases pass in 0.062 seconds.
controlled_replay.limit: Controlled resolver-boundary replay on macOS, not a native Windows execution. The actual Windows CI result remains separately required.
